name: global developmental delay, progressive ataxia, and elevated glutamine
description: An autosomal recessive disease characterized by early-onset delay in motor skills, delayed speech, progressive ataxia, and neurologic deterioration. Plasma glutamine is persistently elevated by a factor of 2.5 despite normal plasma ammonia levels.
